other_failure_modes.name: Data Leakage via Aggregations on Combined Data
other_failure_modes.description: Computing group aggregations (such as counts, means, and standard deviations) over a combined dataset containing both training and test data leaks the test set distribution into the training features.

summary: The solution demonstrates strong data science practices overall, including sophisticated out-of-fold target encoding, careful text/date feature engineering, and a blend optimization using SLSQP. However, it contains a critical data leakage flaw in its hierarchical group aggregations section: it computes groupby statistics (means, standard deviations, and frequencies) on the combined train and test dataset, which severely contaminates the training features with information from the test set.
